en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a wooded hillside toward a town and flat plain beyond. On the left stands a small castle‑like building with a round tower and a flag flying on top. Below and to the right stretches a settlement of houses, church spires, and fields. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as Radebeul-West, Kötzschenbroda, and names the hilltop structure 'Die Friedensburg'.
